# Prime One Cleaning Ltd

> Prime One Cleaning Ltd is a professional cleaning company based in Luton, Bedfordshire, UK. We provide residential, commercial, end of tenancy, after builders, and carpet & upholstery cleaning services to homes and businesses across Luton, Milton Keynes, Bedford, Leighton Buzzard, Dunstable, Hitchin, St Albans, Hemel Hempstead, Watford, and Aylesbury.

## Business Details
- Name: Prime One Cleaning Ltd
- Type: Professional cleaning company
- Phone: 07512 345 678
- Email: info@primeonecleaning.co.uk
- Website: https://primeonecleaning.co.uk
- Location: Luton, Bedfordshire, UK
- Hours: Monday-Saturday, 08:00-18:00
- Fully insured, DBS-checked, vetted team
- Eco-friendly cleaning products
- 5.0 Google rating, 100+ reviews

## Services
1. Residential Cleaning — Regular weekly/fortnightly cleans, deep cleaning, one-off cleans, spring cleaning for homes across Luton & Bedfordshire.
2. End of Tenancy Cleaning — Full property deep clean for tenants, landlords, and letting agents. Checklist-based with re-clean guarantee.
3. After Builders Cleaning — Post-construction and renovation cleaning including dust removal, debris removal, paint splash removal, and site-ready handover.
4. Commercial Cleaning — Office, clinic, retail, gym, and salon cleaning with flexible scheduling outside business hours. Ongoing contracts or one-off deep cleans.
5. Carpet & Upholstery Cleaning — Hot water extraction deep cleaning for carpets, rugs, sofas, and upholstery. Stain and odour removal treatment.

## Areas Served
Luton, Milton Keynes, Bedford, Leighton Buzzard, Dunstable, Hitchin, St Albans, Hemel Hempstead, Watford, Aylesbury, and across Bedfordshire.
